result.summary: PAS transfer MSG00802 to WARD-B failed with 503 ward_unavailable. There is no receipt (404), so it was not committed and reconcile does not apply. The ward is at v2, epoch 10, WARD-C, set by BEDMGR transfer MSG00803. That transfer has the same 09:20:00Z event time and is not marked later, so it does not supersede MSG00802 under RP-2.3. ELS-2.5 says times that cannot be compared need more evidence (RP-2.4). I re-read the ward state and the timeline and they showed the same thing, so this escalates. A person must decide whether PAS or BEDMGR is authoritative. A resend guarded on v2 would move the patient from WARD-C to WARD-B, a second transfer for one movement (DEP-2.1/2.2). Nothing is written.
preconditions: Ward state for ENC-1008 is still at version 2, epoch 10, ward WARD-C, at review
No later event for ENC-1008 after the two 09:20:00Z transfers
If a person later chooses resend: the case's own operation unchanged, expected_version equal to the receiver's current version (now 2), with conditional_writes still true

disagreements.why_kept: Conformance gave resend at 0.8 because MSG00802 is a valid ADT A02, the key matches, it failed with 503 and has no receipt. It left open whether the transfer still holds. A BEDMGR transfer with an equal event time to WARD-C was applied at v2, so ELS-2.5 means supersession is unknown and the RP-2 resend preconditions are not met.

response.content: I submitted an escalate plan for C-000009: the PAS transfer to WARD-B and the BEDMGR transfer to WARD-C have the same 09:20 event time, so a person must decide which source is right; nothing is written, and Conformance's resend view is kept as a disagreement.
